title: Sparkly crown
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Crown base -->
  <rect x="25" y="62" width="50" height="18" rx="5" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <!-- Crown base lighter highlight -->
  <rect x="25" y="62" width="50" height="6" rx="5" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <!-- Crown base bottom edge shade -->
  <rect x="25" y="74" width="50" height="6" rx="4" fill="#E6B800"/>
  <!-- Crown points -->
  <polygon points="28,62 32,30 42,50 50,22 58,50 68,30 72,62" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <!-- Crown point highlight -->
  <polygon points="28,62 32,30 42,50 50,22 58,50 68,30 72,62" fill="none" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <!-- Jewels on crown -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="71" r="4" fill="#FF3366"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="71" r="4" fill="#33CCFF"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="71" r="4" fill="#FF3366"/>
  <!-- Jewel highlights -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="70" r="1.5" fill="#FF99BB"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="70" r="1.5" fill="#99EEFF"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="70" r="1.5" fill="#FF99BB"/>
  <!-- Gem at top point -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="26" r="4" fill="#FF33CC"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="25" r="1.5" fill="#FF99EE"/>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <!-- Sparkle 1 top left -->
  <g transform="translate(18,20)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-6" x2="0" y2="6" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-6" y1="0" x2="6" y2="0" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-4" y1="-4" x2="4" y2="4" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-4" y1="4" x2="4" y2="-4" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 2 top right -->
  <g transform="translate(82,18)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-5" x2="0" y2="5" stroke="#FFEE88" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-5" y1="0" x2="5" y2="0" stroke="#FFEE88" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-3" y1="-3" x2="3" y2="3" stroke="#FFEE88" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-3" y1="3" x2="3" y2="-3" stroke="#FFEE88" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 3 small left -->
  <g transform="translate(12,45)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-4" x2="0" y2="4" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-4" y1="0" x2="4" y2="0" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 4 small right -->
  <g transform="translate(88,50)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-4" x2="0" y2="4" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-4" y1="0" x2="4" y2="0" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 5 top center small -->
  <g transform="translate(50,8)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-4" x2="0" y2="4" stroke="#FFF4AA" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-4" y1="0" x2="4" y2="0" stroke="#FFF4AA" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 6 bottom left -->
  <g transform="translate(15,78)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-3" x2="0" y2="3" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-3" y1="0" x2="3" y2="0" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-2" y1="-2" x2="2" y2="2" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-2" y1="2" x2="2" y2="-2" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 7 bottom right -->
  <g transform="translate(85,80)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-3" x2="0" y2="3" stroke="#FFEE88" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-3" y1="0" x2="3" y2="0" stroke="#FFEE88" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-2" y1="-2" x2="2" y2="2" stroke="#FFEE88" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-2" y1="2" x2="2" y2="-2" stroke="#FFEE88" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
</svg>
